aboutText: Car Service Mechanic Maidstone & Maribyrnong delivers specialised logbook servicing to keep your manufacturer warranty intact. We offer pre-purchase inspections, brakes & suspension checks, and auto electrical diagnostics for all makes and models. Located at Unit 8/61 Wattle Road, Maidstone, we proudly serve Maidstone, Maribyrnong, and surrounding western Melbourne suburbs with years of trusted experience in car care.
servicesText: We provide a full range of car maintenance and repair services, from logbook servicing to engine repairs. Our team specialises in brakes, suspension, and auto electrical systems, ensuring your vehicle performs reliably on Melbourne roads. All makes and models are welcome at our Maidstone workshop.
